_note: Player naming. giver = the NPC id (world.json / speakers.json) whose conversation is followed by the naming offer (dialogue: that conversation, whose speaker lines must use the same id). start = the name a new game begins with (an empty suffix = just the prefix). ranks: every rank in order; endings: a placeholder per rank for later rank-based names (not used yet: get_player_name() shows the chosen name). player_speaker = the speakers.json id of the player: its name plate shows the player name; every other speaker name is blocked.
